claims.claim: NewMCPServerByName declares a server with no command and no URL
WithMCPEndpoints registers a resolver; the SDK calls Resolve once per name-only server at open and uses URL and headers
StaticMCPEndpointResolver and MapMCPEndpointResolver; MCPEndpoint has URL and Headers
Open errors with no resolver, or when the resolver returns an empty URL; servers with URL or command bypass the resolver
